title: Asymmetric Linear-Combination-of-Unitaries Realization of Quantum Convolution via Modular Adders
summary: Discrete circular convolution over $\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ is a linear operator and can be implemented on quantum hardware within the linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) framework. In this work, we make this connection explicit through an asymmetric-LCU formulation: circular convolution is the postselected block of a circuit whose controlled-shift unitary is modular addition on computational-basis states.
